Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de componente pentru industria aviatică și aerospațială și Fabricația de produse pentru apărare și domeniul spațial
Location: Bucharest, Romania
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.
 Job Summary
 CMA CGM is a global leader in maritime transport. It shares its maritime transport information system with its customers and partners through its key solution: the B2B API.
You will become part of the DevOps discipline, being surrounded by other experienced colleagues.
In terms of project, you will work closely with other colleagues from France, using the Agile methodology.
 Responsibilities:
Automate deployment, testing, and monitoring processes.
Optimize the reliability, scalability, and security of cloud and on-premise infrastructures.
Collaborate with development teams (Java/Spring Boot) to improve CI/CD and environment management.
Availability for on-call activities and overtime based on project needs – working hours: Monday-Friday, 09:00-18:00
 Required Skills & Experience:
CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, XL Release/XL Deploy
Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, OpenShift)
Cloud: AWS (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, Kinesis, RDS, S3), Azure or GCP (a plus)
Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Rancher
Scripting: Bash, Python, PowerShell
Network & Security: Firewalls, VPN, IAM, certificate management, vulnerability scanning (SonarQube, Trivy)
DevOps Tools: Git, Jira, Confluence, Nexus/Artifactory
Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL, NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra)
Infra as code: Terraform
API Gateway: Apigee, Kong
 Nice to have:
Serverless: AWS Lambda, Azure Functions
Automation: Rundeck, Airflow
Tools: Insomnia, JMeter
 Behavioral skills:
Autonomy: Ability to work independently and take initiative.
Problem-Solving: Aptitude for diagnosing and resolving complex incidents.
Team Spirit: Effective collaboration with developers, ops, and security teams.
Adaptability: Ability to adapt to technological changes and project needs.
Communication: Strong technical and non-technical communication (oral/written).
 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
